summary: Lower the intrinsic Promise constructor while preserving synchronous executor invocation and JavaScript resolving functions.

target.notes: Executor runs synchronously; helper resolve/reject functions implement JS first-call, self-resolution, and thenable adoption rules.

caveats: TaskCompletionSource alone does not implement Promise resolution or microtask semantics.

tests.name: executor runs synchronously
tests.expected_csharp: var p = JsPromise.Create((resolve, reject) => { Console.WriteLine(1); resolve(JsValue.From(2d)); });

tests.name: executor throw becomes rejection
tests.expected_behavior: prints after before rejection handler logs x
